q: The Smale Horseshoe map is significant because it demonstrates:
opts: A map with a single stable fixed point
That chaotic dynamics (Bernoulli shift) can be embedded in a simple geometric map of a square
That all planar maps are integrable
A map with no periodic points
exp: Smale's horseshoe: a simple folding+stretching map contains an invariant Cantor set on which the dynamics is topologically conjugate to the full 2-shift (Bernoulli shift). This is the archetype for deterministic chaos embedded in simple systems.
